title: Nali
notes: Early Italian pop mixes British-leaning arrangements, selective electronics and emotionally contrasting songs.

title: Mentre tutto cambia
notes: Intimate melodic pop balances piano, strings, retro styling and occasional electronic arrangements.

title: Non so ballare
notes: Melodic pop-rock features jazz passages, retro songwriting and emotionally nuanced vocal interpretations.

title: Splende
notes: Orchestral ballads and melodic pop-rock dominate; occasional electronic textures support bigger vocal arrangements.

title: Se avessi un cuore
notes: Synths and programmed beats anchor dance-led songwriting; one orchestral ballad remains an exception.

title: Bye Bye
notes: Canova-led electronic pop spans reggaeton-tinged grooves, EDM, trap accents and reflective ballads.

title: Nuda
notes: Electronic pop and trap-pop collaborations alternate with more restrained melodic songs.

title: E poi siamo finiti nel vortice
notes: Precise synth-led dance-pop balances euphoric rhythms with vulnerable melodies and ironic lyrics.

title: Ma io sono fuoco
notes: Eighties-inspired synthetic dance-pop blends sharp relationship writing, muscular grooves and occasional ballads.
